entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it was.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no denying what we just saw.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Based on what we've seen, we can[n]surmise that Dr. Maruki's memory was[n]somehow on that videotape.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: The way that woman was acting at[n]the end... That's just how it went[n]for me, too...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering what he was saying in the[n]video, that might have been the moment[n]he first awakened to his ability.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Could Dr. Maruki possibly have[n]wanted us to watch this memory?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Eh, I don't think that's the case...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's possible that this is just an old[n]memory he tried to bury in his[n]unconscious mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Still, if this actually occurred, there's[n]no mistaking it for a trivial memory—[n]this is clearly important to Maruki.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Whether for good or bad, it appears that[n]this incident is what led Dr. Maruki to[n]his current mission...
